Thanks — quick read through the attachment, high level notes below:

- Lobby/sponsor loop: 2x 55" screens are fine for branding; ensure they have HDMI + DisplayPort and local media player fallback. Add a 3rd screen at the internal stair for sightline.
- Capture: For the overflow lobby stream use a single PTZ on ethernet with POE injector. We'll need an NDI output from the capture box to feed the bridge. If Atlas has limited switch ports, we should request a small managed switch on the AV vendor PO.
- Breakout B (quiet zone): USB-C presentation cube is fine, but we need a small audio desk + one shotgun mic on stand for fireside conversation capture.
- Bridge isolation: Recommend dedicated VLAN and QoS tags (DSCP EF for audio, AF41 for video). We will supply a small encoder appliance (Redwood bridge appliance) that will rack in the comms room — need 2RU space + 1x 10Gb SFP+ port.
- Recording & redundancy: local ISO recording per room + central backup to a removable SSD.

Inventory callouts (what we'll ship): 1x NDI PTZ, 1x encoder appliance (2RU), 2x battery-backed audio desks, cabling kit. Please confirm customs lead time if devices are shipping from outside CA.

I'll attach a short AV checklist and example rack diagram later today.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior AV Engineer | Redwood Inference
